headline: Anthropic Books $35 Billion To Nvidia-Backed Lambda For Cloud Capacity
snippet: Anthropic has signed a $35 billion cloud computing agreement with Nvidia-backed Lambda, structured around Hut 8's Beacon Point data center in Texas.

headline: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda
snippet: The roughly 350-megawatt facility will use Nvidia chips supplied to Lambda. Nvidia itself will hold the lease on the data center, and Lambda will then use the facility to provide computing capacity to Anthropic.

headline: Hut 8 stock is a winner in a new deal between Anthropic and Nvidia-backed Lambda
snippet: The data center is being developed by Hut 8 in Nueces County, Texas. Hut 8 is building additional Texas data centers for Anthropic that will run on Google's tensor processing units instead of Nvidia hardware.

headline: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
snippet: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release. In expert-led testing the model found previously unknown vulnerabilities in a browser and an OS kernel and built working exploits.

headline: OpenAI Says New Model Meets Its 'Critical' Cybersecurity Threshold
snippet: Astra meets the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, meaning that with the right tools and access, it can find previously unknown security flaws and develop ways to exploit them across many well-protected systems without a person guiding each step.

headline: OpenAI clears Astra for release after critical cybersecurity rating
snippet: OpenAI said it plans to release its Astra model after determining that new safeguards are sufficient to manage the risks posed by the system, which the company has designated as meeting its highest cybersecurity capability threshold.

headline: OpenAI Reveals Astra, Its First AI Model to Reach 'Critical' Cybersecurity Risk Threshold
snippet: The company introduced stronger restrictions on Astra, including stricter isolation, checkpoint encryption, monitoring of tool-use sessions, and additional controls to detect potentially harmful or unauthorized model behavior.

headline: GPT-6 Astra is the First Model OpenAI Classifies as Critical for Cybersecurity

headline: OpenAI Astra Hits Critical Cyber Risk, 2-Week Pause [2026]
snippet: OpenAI delayed Astra, paused and later restarted frontier reinforcement learning after the Hugging Face incident, and said the strongest cyber workflows will initially be restricted to alpha testers and Daybreak Blue defenders.

headline: The U.S. Military Now Has Its Own Versions of ChatGPT and Grok
snippet: On August 31, 2026, the Department of Defense added two more models to GenAI.mil — ChatGPT Mil from OpenAI and Grok for Government from SpaceX's Starshield AI division — joining Google Gemini on what is now the military's official AI hub for 3 million total staff.

headline: Pentagon Adds ChatGPT Mil and Grok to Its GenAI.mil AI Portal
snippet: ChatGPT Mil and Grok for Government became usable on GenAI.mil on August 31, giving authorized US service members, civilian employees, and contractors two new model services alongside Google's Gemini.
